'''Fotbal Club Vulturii Cutezători''', also known as '''Vulturii Cutezători''', or just '''Vulturii''' is a Moldovan football club, based in [[Sîngerei]], which competes in [[Moldovan Liga 2|Liga 1]], the second tier of [[Football in Moldova|Moldovan Football]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Moldova - Vulturii Cutezători - Rezultate, program, echipă, statistici, foto, video şi ştiri |url=https://ro.soccerway.com/teams/moldova/vulturii-cuteztori/59732/ |website=ro.soccerway.com}}</ref>"}}
